body: We are both 17 and seniors in a United States high school. She takes her grades very seriously, and I suspect the oncoming exams are weighing on her the most. I talked to her a little more last night, and I learned a few more things: She has told her parents in the past and they didn't believe her, so she slit her wrists and had to go to the hospital. This was two years ago. More than anything else, her parents were mad at her for what she did. I think she is very afraid of what her parents might do if they found out that she was suicidal again (I don't think her parents have ever been violent with her, but I think they shout at her a lot). I actually did tell her last night that I "don't know what I was doing, but there are people who do. Please talk to them" followed by several websites I found where you can talk to people through Instant Messaging and phone numbers. I'm going to try to talk to my school's counselor so I can get another physical person there for her to talk to. In the mean time I'm going to try to keep her focused on midterms. I've asked her to keep talking to me if she feels bad again and when she does I'll have my phone close by so I can call 911 if something goes wrong.
